tasks.label: clojure: uber with inputs
args: alias_arg="${input:cljAlias}"; main_arg="${input:mainClass}"; if [ -n "$alias_arg" ] && [ -n "$main_arg" ]; then bb uber :aliases "$alias_arg" :main "$main_arg"; elif [ -n "$alias_arg" ]; then bb uber :aliases "$alias_arg"; elif [ -n "$main_arg" ]; then bb uber :main "$main_arg"; else bb uber; fi
